_readme: One entry per Microsoft Form family (01-07). Filled in during the Phase 2 build session. prefill_template = the 'Get pre-filled link' URL copied from Forms for ANY asset, with the URL-encoded asset value (e.g. %22BOOTH1%22) replaced by {ASSET}. The redirect page substitutes the scanned asset ID. Until a family has a template, its signs show 'Form not live yet - use the paper sheet'.
